# Research image provenance

The sample consists of public Wikimedia Commons photographs under the per-image licenses recorded in `attribution_manifest.csv`. The 460 contact assets are four representations of 115 included photographs, not 460 independent observations.

IDs printed beneath images match the manifest's `image_id`. The manifest records source page, photographer, license and license URL; linked HTML neighbor/cluster sheets repeat those credits. PNG contact sheets are visual indexes to that same record. Keep the manifest with any redistribution.

Transformations include resizing, JPEG encoding, person-centered cropping, masking or background substitution for nuisance-intervention tests. An intervention image is a research derivative, not an unaltered documentary photograph. Individual images and adapted images retain their applicable source license, including ShareAlike conditions; no blanket code license overrides them. A collage does not grant new rights over its component images.

This convenience sample was acquired for visual research. It is not representative of cities, subcultures, purchases or current trends. No identity, sensitive demographic inference or individual shopping history is attached to the images.
